protocol.target: actual BC end_price > start_price; one observed decision per real settled round
protocol.inputs: decision snapshot and books received by its PC timestamp; no end/start prices or final pools
protocol.split: earliest 60% book-covered rounds development, next 20% calibration, final 20% historical test
protocol.cv: three expanding past-only folds; 60 seconds purged by settlement time; trailing training block calibrates each fold
protocol.selection_all: pooled chronological-CV accuracy, then lower log loss
protocol.selection_selective: largest pooled Wilson95 lower accuracy; >=200 calls and >=10% coverage; target top 25%
protocol.calibration: logit temperature in [0.001,2], fit only before the scored block
protocol.inference: UP/DOWN symmetric; no bias, mirrored trees; no prediction with insufficient books
protocol.caveat: history was examined previously; historical holdout is not prospective proof
